name: AJGA (American Junior Golf Association)
pathway_summary: Premier US junior tour for ages 12-18; performance here drives college recruiting. PBE (Performance Based Entry) status earned through finishes; top juniors invited to AJGA Invitationals and Rolex Tournament of Champions

name: Hurricane Junior Golf Tour
pathway_summary: Largest multi-day junior tour (ages 8-18); Open / College Prep / Major / Invitational events across the US. Recognized by JGS / Junior Golf Hub / GJGR ranking systems

name: IJGT (International Junior Golf Tour)
pathway_summary: Hosted by IJGA Academy; events across the US plus the Race to Scotland series. Schedule lives on BlueGolf

name: Future Champions Golf (FCG)
pathway_summary: San Diego-based national junior tour (ages 5-18); National Tour events plus FCG International and Callaway World Championship majors. Junior World Qualifier (JWQ) events feed the Junior World Championship

name: US Kids Golf Teen Series
pathway_summary: Two-day weekend events for ages 13-18 at quality courses nationwide; an affordable step up from local tours with JGS-recognized results

name: PKBGT (Peggy Kirk Bell Girls Golf Tour)
pathway_summary: The largest girls-only junior tour in the US; Bell National and regional series events plus NB3 National Championship qualifiers. Strong college-recruiting pipeline for female golfers

name: Met PGA Junior Tour
pathway_summary: Metropolitan PGA section junior tour (NY / NJ / CT); two-day Future Series events plus the Met Junior PGA Championship. A strong regional proving ground for Northeast juniors

name: FCWT Junior Golf Tour
pathway_summary: Future Collegians World Tour; college-prep junior events at championship courses in the Northeast and Florida plus a national championship. 2026 schedule posts on BlueGolf

name: IMG Academy Junior Golf Tour
pathway_summary: IMG Academy's junior tour; events feed the IMG Academy Junior World Championship at Torrey Pines. 2026 schedule posts on Golf Genius

name: Legends Junior Tour (Texas)
pathway_summary: Texas Golf Association's elite junior series for ages 12-18; multi-day ranked events across Texas including the Byron Nelson Junior Championship and Texas Junior Amateur

name: Florida Junior Tour (FJT)
pathway_summary: Florida State Golf Association's junior tour; two-day FJT Opens plus Boys' and Girls' Junior Championships across Florida; strong Junior Golf Scoreboard exposure

name: SCPGA Junior Tour (Toyota Tour Cup)
pathway_summary: Southern California PGA's elite Toyota Tour Cup series; invitation via Qualifying School or Players Tour points; all events ranked by Junior Golf Scoreboard and earn AJGA PBE stars. Weekly Players Tour one-day events also run year-round

name: GSGA Junior Tour (Georgia)
pathway_summary: Georgia State Golf Association's junior tour; 18-hole one-day events plus Points Per Series challenges and championship regional qualifiers across Georgia

name: CGA Junior / TYGA (Carolinas)
pathway_summary: Carolinas Golf Association junior championships for NC and SC juniors; state junior championships and match plays plus invitationals; TYGA one-day and multi-day events feed these championships

name: JGAA (Arizona)
pathway_summary: Junior Golf Association of Arizona; year-round championships and invitationals including the PING Junior Masters Series and Arizona Junior Amateur; strong D1 recruiting pipeline

name: Sneds Tour (Tennessee)
pathway_summary: Tennessee Golf Foundation's junior tour named for Brandt Snedeker; Opens plus Elite and Masters two-day events across Tennessee with a strong college-coach following

name: NTPGA Junior Tour (North Texas)
pathway_summary: Northern Texas PGA's junior program; the All-American Tour and majors shown here are the elite tier that college coaches follow. Medalist and Prep tiers also run year-round

name: JTNC (Northern California)
pathway_summary: Junior Tour of Northern California; Spring plus Summer plus Fall and Holiday series with a season-ending Tour Championship at Poppy Hills; run by the NCGA

name: VSGA Junior (Virginia)
pathway_summary: Virginia State Golf Association junior championships plus 18-hole Junior Golf Circuit stroke-play events; includes the VSGA Junior Stroke Play and Match Play Championships

name: IJGA (Illinois)
pathway_summary: Illinois Junior Golf Association; ISJA and CEJA qualifiers plus 18-hole tour stops, invitationals and the Players Challenge across Chicagoland and downstate Illinois

name: Colorado PGA Junior
pathway_summary: Colorado PGA Junior Tour (successor to the JGAC); Cup series events, Mizuno majors, qualifiers and the West Swing across Colorado with Q-School entry events

name: Southern Ohio PGA Junior
pathway_summary: Southern Ohio PGA Junior Tour; one-day stroke play events plus a Tour Championship across Cincinnati, Dayton and Columbus

name: GAM Junior (Michigan)
pathway_summary: Golf Association of Michigan junior championships; Michigan Junior Amateur, GAM Boys and Girls Championships plus USGA Junior Amateur qualifiers

name: NJPGA Junior (New Jersey)
pathway_summary: New Jersey PGA Junior Tour; majors, opens and one-day Junior Events at courses across New Jersey with a season points race

name: Philadelphia PGA Junior
pathway_summary: Philadelphia PGA Section Junior Tour; one-day events plus the Junior Tour Championship and Harry Hammond Invitational across greater Philadelphia, South Jersey and Delaware

name: MAPGA Junior Tour (Maryland/DC)
pathway_summary: Middle Atlantic PGA junior tour; Championship and Patriot division events across Maryland, DC and Northern Virginia including AJGA and JGS ranked invitationals plus Optimist, Jr PGA and Capital Cup qualifiers
